practice_observation: The first draft overreached into other owners' areas and the kernel's invariants (a kernel dither, a duplicate water class, a duplicate plate tool, a dependency group against an ADR, a check that holds by construction); only a reviewer on a different model found them, 8 blocking. Lessons kept: check each proposed card against the existing ADRs and sibling plans for ownership and invariants, and give every hard check a must-fail control. A baseline taken from another outcome's total wall clock (27.3 h) instead of its separated working time (about 5.7 h) was caught the same way, so take baselines from labelled closeout facts. Short capped spikes changed the recommendation (models should make assets, not frames; a hosted edit needs an outside-identity check). CI wait was about 4.7 of 5.7 h behind the single runner; the coordinator's merge queue then gave one push, one verify, merge. Unknown: whether four default Opus research agents (15.6 M tokens, mostly cache reads) were worth it against Sonnet.
